दिन्व् €1 P. (दिन्वति)
—1 To be glad, or to gladden.
—2 To please, or to be pleased.

दीन a. [दी-क्त तस्य न]
—1 Poor, indigent.
—2 Distressed, ruined, afflicted, miserable, wretched.
—3 Sorry, dejected, melancholy, sad; सा विरहे तव दीना Gīt. 4.
—4 Timid, frightened.
—5 Mean, piteous; यं यं पश्यसि तस्य तस्य पुरतो मा ब्रूहि दीनं
 वचः Bh. 2. 51.
